Interface StreamingSubscriptions

All Known Implementing Classes:
StreamingSubscriptionsImpl
public interface StreamingSubscriptions
Client interface for managing IBX SmartView streaming subscriptions. Provides methods to list, retrieve, and create streaming subscriptions that enable real-time delivery of environmental and power data from monitored IBX assets.

    • getSubscriptionData

      SubscriptionData getSubscriptionData(String subscriptionId, List<String> ibxs, List<String> messageTypes, List<String> streamIds, Integer offset, Integer limit)
      Retrieves the near real-time data associated with a specific subscription, narrowed by the given filters and pagination.
      Parameters:
      subscriptionId - the unique identifier of the subscription
      ibxs - filter to the given set of IBXs, or null for all
      messageTypes - filter to the given message types (ALARM, ALERT, ENVIRONMENTAL, METERED_POWER, POWER, TAG_POINT), or null for all
      streamIds - filter to the given set of stream IDs, or null for all
      offset - the zero-based offset of the first item, or null for the default
      limit - the maximum number of items to return, or null for the default (250)
      Returns:
      the subscription data
